context: User explicitly approved continuing navigation33 and reader-count repair after feedback approval gate.

readerCount.fix: The unique DOI+hashed-IP event insert, per-DOI authoritative recount/upsert, and returned count are executed in one D1 batch transaction. A duplicate genuine open reconciles a stale/missing materialized row from the v3 event ledger without adding a reader. Dedupe semantics remain one IP per DOI.
readerCount.interpretation: The latent split-write undercount defect is fixed, but the current production aggregate did not show a ledger/materialized mismatch before or after deployment. Because 130 distinct DOI×IP opens are spread across 106 papers, at least 82 of those papers must currently have exactly one counted reader. Therefore the observation that many cards show 1 is largely compatible with the chosen per-DOI IP-dedup rule and is not fully explained by the fixed defect.
